newsitem.title: UK: UBS makes Regan head of Europe fixed income.
newsitem.headline: UBS makes Regan head of Europe fixed income.

text.p: UBS Ltd said on Thursday it had appointed Kevin Regan as head of its European fixed income sales in an effort to strengthen its fixed income and derivatives operation in Europe.
UBS said in a statement that Regan would lead a pan-European team to further develop and serve the company's European/Middle Eastern client base.
"This appointment follows several initiatives launched by UBS in the fixed income and derivatives area in Europe to further grow and expand UBS's dominant franchise," the statement said.

Earlier in the year, UBS combined its European government bond and swap trading activities, refocused its financing and new issue activities, streamlined the Credit Trading business and expanded its Emerging Markets activities.
The statement said Regan had spent 12 years at Merrill Lynch and previously, seven years at CSFB.
